message: Initialized the dual-host plugin migration map; implementation and release side effects are deferred.
Selected one canonical protocol with native Codex and Claude packaging surfaces.
Snapshot completed: copied 0.2.0 source to plugins/adaptive-writing-plans/, excluded .git and local state, recorded baseline.
MCP refactored to SDK-backed context-scoped service: created context.mjs, server-sdk.mjs, updated .mcp.json, added dependencies, tests pass.

Provider composition made host-neutral: created provider-composition.mjs with verifyProviderWorkflowOutcome, removed host-adapter.mjs, sync-host-adapter.mjs, host:sync script, HOST_PROFILES. Discovery remains observational, never automatic.
Packaged dual-host manifests and catalogs: created .claude-plugin/ and .codex-plugin/ manifests, marketplace catalogs, README (EN/CN), LICENSE, migration docs. Version 0.3.0, no machine paths leaked.
Bootstrap map and release boundary completed
Canary test and release preparation completed
All seven waves completed successfully. Plugin ready for release.
